element_inventory: PRECONDITION: gap-up stock that spikes in pre-market, then consolidates/trades sideways into the open
ORB level = high of the first 5-minute candle (e.g. VCIG 3.94)
ENTRY: buy a starter position on breakout above the ORB level
VWAP FILTER: stock must break/hold above VWAP for bigger gap-and-go potential; immediate VWAP rejection at open (NUWE, Lucy) = failed setup / avoid
SELECTION: stock must actually get above its ORB level with follow-through (NUWE never cleared its ORB level; Lucy popped only ~7c above then reversed â€” no trade)
EXIT: scale out into the initial spike (partial profits on the pop)
EXIT: take further profits when consolidation above VWAP forms lower highs (bearish top signal)
strategies.entry_summary: On a gap-up stock that spikes in pre-market then consolidates sideways into the open, mark the high of the first 5-minute candle as the opening range breakout (ORB) level (e.g. VCIG 3.94). Enter a starter position as price breaks out above that ORB level. A key qualifier: the stock should be able to break and hold above VWAP â€” that is the Telltale sign of a stock with real gap-and-go potential.
strategies.exit_summary: Scale out into the initial spike (took profits in the 420s on the pop). Take further profits as it trades sideways/consolidates above VWAP and starts forming lower highs â€” that consolidation with lower highs is the bearish top-of-move signal before stocks typically fall back under VWAP and fade to lows. Manage risk so you don't hold through the big pullback/sell-off.
strategies.name: orb_gap_and_go
